description: Audit helix-cad-validate SKILL.md + validate.py for the harness-engineering contract: deterministic Computational Sensor + Gate, fail-safe, contract read-only, engineer sign-off.

checks.desc: Frontmatter has name == directory and a description with Vietnamese + English 'Triggers on:' phrases.
checks.assert: name: helix-cad-validate present; description includes 'Triggers on:' and both VI + EN trigger phrases.

checks.desc: Validator is deterministic CPU code, not an LLM judging safety.
checks.assert: validate.py uses only stdlib (json, hashlib, argparse, sys, datetime); no network/LLM import; SKILL states 'cơ-chế-không-phải-prompt' and 'No LLM'.

checks.desc: Missing or low-confidence data for a critical rule yields FAIL, never silent skip.
checks.assert: run_checks emits FAIL when required data absent; confidence below min_confidence for critical rule => FAIL.

checks.desc: FAIL closes the gate (non-zero exit) and blocks forge-fabrication handoff / ICD freeze.
checks.assert: main returns 2 on FAIL; report 'gate' field = CLOSED; SKILL Step 5 blocks handoff.

checks.desc: Contract integrity guarded against agent self-editing the rules.
checks.assert: --approved-hash compares sha256; mismatch => contract_integrity FAIL; SKILL marks contract Core (C), read-only-to-agent.

checks.desc: PASS is minimum-bar only; engineer-of-record sign-off remains mandatory, no auto-merge.
checks.assert: MD report includes engineer sign-off block; SKILL Step 6 + COD mark final sign-off Core (C), 'PASS ≠ an toàn'.

checks.desc: Documents BƯỚC 1 scope and defers middleware/eval/inferential to explicit triggers (no over-engineering).
checks.assert: SKILL 'When to add the next tier' table ties each added tier to a concrete trigger, citing the DEBATE.
